Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up.

Short answer: when an attendee forwards a GCal invite to an external address some clients (and Exchange proxies) strip the private Meet URL; that results in the blank/404 you're seeing. To fix quickly I can:

- Re-create the event from my account and send a fresh invite (this makes me the organizer) OR
- Send a one-off Zoom backup link to Jordan and keep the existing GCal event as-is.

If you want the meeting to remain in your team's calendar with full RSVP metadata, the clean path is that I reissue the invite as the organizer so the link is canonical. If you're ok with Zoom as a backup, I'll drop a join link and attach the demo agenda.

Proposed times: 2:00pm PT (same slot) or 3:30pm PT. Which do you prefer?

Attaching a short agenda so Jordan has context.

Thanks,
Ben
